To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the DNS is a very useful tool for discerning content and the organization providing it.
the Internet's DNS system can be used to identify content and services, and that this can be done with a very small fraction of the DNS traffic.

(1) DNS is the key to understanding content, services, and the organizations providing them; (2) DNS is the only way to understand content, services, organizations providing them, and where the content resides; (3) DNS provides the only means to understand content, service, and organization in a timely and cost-effective manner; (4) DNS is a key enabler of the Internet ecosystem; and (5) DNS is the glue that binds the Internet together.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of discerning the content of a given flow and its association with the owner of the content and its hosting service provider.
the following problem - how can we discern the association between the owner of content, the content itself, and the service provider that hosts the content?
the problem of discerning the association between a given piece of content and its owner and the host where it resides.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
DNS has evolved into a powerful tool for content and service differentiation.
the Internet today is a very tangled web.
DNS is the only technology that can provide the required information for the network to make the right decisions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a novel approach to identify the content and the service provider in the Internet.
DNS can play a major role in the above problem.
DNS can be used to help unravel this web.
The main takeaway from our work is that
DNS is the key to the tangled web.

we can use the Domain Name System (DNS) to infer the association between the owner, content, and the hosting infrastructure, which in turn can help us understand the traffic patterns and make informed traffic management decisions.
we can leverage the DNS infrastructure to help discern the content, the owner and the hosting provider.
